headline: Keep your FPL routine short: one weekly check, then make a calm, safe-leaning final call before the deadline.

points.text: Creator Let's Talk FPL posts several weekly videos on team news, injuries and transfers. Each one is a sponsored video.
points.label: reported

points.text: Recent team news includes a Raya injury and a João Pedro absence, according to video titles. Check the official squad news before you lock your team.
points.label: reported

points.text: One creator says the Gameweek 11 team is set and suggests waiting before making a transfer, with a short 'more this week or next?' question.
points.label: opinion

points.text: A creator asks whether selling Haaland soon is crazy. This is a question, not a recommendation.
points.label: opinion

differences.text: One creator treats Wirtz as a key question for Gameweek 12, while another frames the week around injuries and a possible Haaland sale. Each one is one creator's view.
